items.title: Swasthi — Multi-Platform Health & MealPlan Engine
items.description: Architected the complete backend ecosystem for a consumer nutrition and health platform connecting 4 surfaces: Coach App, Admin Panel, Swasthi Mobile App, and Web Client. Engineered a 5-level relational hierarchy in PostgreSQL via Drizzle ORM with an automated Copy-on-Write (CoW) deep-cloning versioning engine protecting active subscribers from live mutations. Implemented dynamic mathematical macro rollups, calendar day-offset dynamic week progression with progressive content locking, self-healing checkout with account auto-registration, and FCM push notifications.

items.title: Backend SAM Infra
items.description: Architected and deployed a production-ready serverless backend on AWS SAM - solo. Hybrid microservices + monolith design where every feature maps to its own Lambda, enabling macro-to-micro scaling by just plugging in a new function. Includes Lambda layers for shared deps, Secrets Manager for env management across dev/prod, S3, API Gateway, EventBridge, and SQS - all wired for local, dev, and production parity.

items.title: Studio - A Tri Platform Gym Booking System
items.description: A full-stack platform for booking gym/studio slots, consisting of a user-facing website, a dedicated mobile app for studio owners to list and manage their gyms, and an admin panel to handle users, bookings, payments, and support queries.

Architected and delivered the complete backend for Swasthi (consumer mobile health app) and a multi-platform MealPlan engine unifying 4 client surfaces: Coach App, Admin Panel, Swasthi Mobile, and Web Portal. Designed a 5-level hierarchical relational schema in PostgreSQL using Drizzle ORM, built an automated Copy-on-Write (CoW) version-lock engine to safeguard active subscribers, implemented a dynamic mathematical macro-propagation engine, and deployed dual-runtime microservices on AWS SAM and serverless NestJS on AWS Lambda.
Integrated PayU payment gateway for in-app transactions. Built the e-commerce backend covering both the website and admin panel. Developed the studio listing system for the public-facing website.
Built and maintained online tutoring platform for K-12 students. Implemented features like tutor onboard journey, tutor search, and subscription based payments.
